text:
Aria: Hey team, Im landing my first tiny change (branch: feat/aria/route-fallback). CI is failing on pre-commit and one typing error. Also not 100% on commit message format and who should review/merge. Any quick first-PR pointers? :wave:

devex-bot: Welcome Aria! Quick checklist -> https://redwood.dev/devex/pr-checklist. Run `./scripts/setup`, then `pre-commit run --all-files`. For linting: `poetry run ruff --fix .` and `poetry run black .`.

Olivia: Hi! Branch name looks good. Our conventions: `feat/` or `fix/` + short slug or ticket, optional initials. Commit messages use Conventional Commits: `feat(runtime): add route fallback` or `fix(api): handle missing header`. Keep PRs small and add a short design note if > 300 LOC.

Mira: Typical CI fails are ruff/black or mypy. Run these locally: `poetry run ruff check .`, `poetry run ruff --fix .`, `poetry run black --check .`, `poetry run mypy src/`. If mypy complains about TypedDicts, often adding `total=False` or Optional[...] fixes it. Paste errors and I can point out the exact line.

Aria: Thanks! Also: do we squash? and how many approvals do we need?

Jess: We use squash-and-merge for feature branches to keep history tidy. For most dirs: 1 approval + green CI. Sensitive areas (infra/, eng-runtime/) need 2 approvers and passing integration tests. CODEOWNERS enforced by branch protections.

Mira: If you need a reviewer, ping the CODEOWNERS for the touched path and one teammate. For runtime stuff ping @Mira. For UI ping @Jess. If unsure, tag @Olivia for quick routing.

Aria: CI shows pre-commit failing on a commit hook I can't reproduce locally. Any ideas?

devex-bot: Sometimes the hook runs in a slightly different environment. Try `pre-commit run --all-files` and ensure your git index is clean. If the hook still fails, paste the first 10 lines of the hook output here.

ci-bot: CI | Build #4582 - Pre-commit failed on commit hooks. Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/4582

Mira: Another trick: run `git checkout -- .` to clear untracked changes, reinstall hooks `pre-commit install --install-hooks`, then re-run. If the failure is a flake8/ruff rule that's flaky, open a short PR comment and we can decide to relax it.

Aria: Fixed the pre-commit env (forgot to `poetry shell`). One remaining mypy error about a TypedDict key. I'll DM Mira for a 15-min pairing. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Olivia: Also remember to add a short manual-test checklist in the PR template if the change affects behavior: steps to reproduce, expected result, any env flags. And include the ticket number in the title (e.g., "2120: route fallback").

Jess: If your PR touches public API, add a note about backward compatibility and a small example in the description.

Aria: Will do — running tests and then will request review from the codeowner and @Mira. Appreciate the help!
